title: Verify: GameLayout stack usage unit tests
summary: Unit tests for Button, icon and drawer state in GameLayout
description: Test GameLayout renders the icon and keeps drawer behavior and that package.json lists the stack.
acceptance_criteria: Given render, then toggle contains svg
Given package.json, then stack deps listed

steps.symbol: new: it('toggle renders Lucide icon and flips drawer-open')
steps.action: Render <GameLayout scene={<div/>} story={<div/>}/>; get button name 'Story'; assert toggle.querySelector('svg') not null; fireEvent.click(toggle); assert container.querySelector('aside') has class 'drawer-open' and toggle aria-expanded 'true'
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/layoutStack.test.tsx -t 'toggle renders'

steps.action: Read package.json with readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'package.json')), JSON.parse, assert dependencies has keys lucide-react, motion, clsx, tailwind-merge, class-variance-authority, @radix-ui/react-slot, @radix-ui/react-dialog and devDependencies has tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/layoutStack.test.tsx -t 'package.json'
